name: racearena-server
description: RaceArena local backend — Phase L. `test` dropped --no-file-parallelism at TEST-ACCOUNTS-1: that flag was serialisation standing in for isolation, and the isolation is now real (a users store per test file, and no shared account). See server/test/env-setup.js.
_overridesNote: DEPS-SERVER-AUDIT-1 (2026-09-04). `npm audit fix` moved the lockfile and fixed NOTHING — it took body-parser to 1.20.6, which cleared that package's own advisory, and left all three counts standing because the root is `qs`. The two remaining advisories (GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx array-limit bypass, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g DoS via attacker-controlled isBuffer) are fixed in qs 6.16.0, and both express 4.22.2 and body-parser 1.20.6 pin `qs: ~6.15.1`, so no in-range resolution can reach it. npm's own advice is `npm audit fix` again, which loops, or express 5 — a MAJOR bump of a direct dependency, which this repository does not take for a moderate DoS advisory. So the resolution is forced HERE, one minor version of one transitive package, rather than by widening an allowlist: an allowlist records that we decided not to care, an override records what we actually run. Remove this when express ships a 4.x that requires a patched qs.
